data.narrative:
Axibo AI is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Anoop Gadhrri, Sohaib Al-Emara, and Reiner Schmidt. The company has raised C$12M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private robotics companies and 1 public peer (277810.KQ), with representative private comparables including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable and forms the primary valuation anchor. Using the C$12M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next-stage rounds, this method implies a valuation of C$30M. The Peer-Median method is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparable data; while the broader robotics sector contains 10 peers, fewer than three fall within the narrow filters required for reliable median extraction.

The triangulated valuation range is C$26M to C$34M, with a median of C$30M. This relatively narrow range reflects reliance on a single applicable method rather than methodological convergence. Key uncertainties include the limited peer set in the specific robotics and manufacturing space—particularly at the Seed stage—and the absence of comparable transaction or momentum data. Any valuation within the C$26M–C$34M band should be treated as preliminary pending additional comparable transactions or clearer revenue/traction milestones.
